# COMMON REPAIR

## Project
- Subtitle: An industrial hall for neighbourhood repair and making
- Use: household repair classes, shared tools and small-scale making
- Direction: adaptation of the existing single-storey assembly hall
- Audience: neighbourhood residents and workshop operators
- Entrance name: COMMON REPAIR
- Entrance phrase: Repair together
- Activity headings: Course Day; Open Workshop

## Geometry
- Site: 30000 × 24000 mm; 720 m2
- Hall exterior: 24000 × 12000 mm; 288 m2
- West, east and north setbacks: 3000 mm each
- South yard depth: 9000 mm
- External brick wall thickness: 300 mm
- Longitudinal structural spacing: 4 × 5850 mm
- Transverse structural span: 11400 mm
- Ground Floor and yard: ±0.000
- Truss underside: +4.800; 4800 mm above datum
- Eaves: +5.400; 5400 mm above datum
- Ridge: +6.900; 6900 mm above datum
- Retained structure: 10 steel columns; 5 steel trusses; concrete floor slab; brick envelope; pitched roof
- Retained openings: 3 doors; 2 south windows; 5 north-pitch rooflights
- Public route clear width: minimum 1500 mm

## Rooms
| ID | Name | Net area | Clear height | Floor |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A-01 | Reception | 18 m2 | 4800 mm | Ground Floor |
| A-02 | Teaching | 54 m2 | 4800 mm | Ground Floor |
| A-03 | Making | 60 m2 | 4800 mm | Ground Floor |
| A-04 | Tool Store | 18 m2 | 3000 mm | Ground Floor |
| A-05 | Intake | 12 m2 | 4800 mm | Ground Floor |
| A-06 | Collection | 12 m2 | 4800 mm | Ground Floor |
| A-07 | Accessible Toilet | 8 m2 | 3000 mm | Ground Floor |
| A-08 | Staff Room | 10 m2 | 3000 mm | Ground Floor |

- Room net area total: 192 m2
- Remaining internal area: circulation, partitions and structure
- Open zones: Reception, Teaching, Making, Intake, Collection
- Enclosed rooms: Tool Store, Accessible Toilet, Staff Room

## Construction palette
- Existing brick: exposed, locally repointed
- Existing steel columns and trusses: exposed, cleaned and recoated
- Existing concrete slab: retained, patched and sealed
- New enclosed-room walls: freestanding timber studs with 18 mm birch plywood lining to 2100 mm and clear glazing above
- New enclosed-room ceiling underside: 3000 mm above datum
- New enclosed-room top: 3100 mm above datum
- New wall to existing brick junction: 20 mm recessed joint
- New work drawing label: New
- Removed partition drawing label: Removed

## Operations
- Visitor entrance: D-01
- Item delivery entrance: D-02
- Item sequence: Intake; Making; Collection
- Tool lending counter: visible from Reception
- Course Day: 12 learners; 8 makers; 2 operators; 22 people total
- Open Workshop: 6 learners; 8 makers; 2 operators; 16 people total
- Complete closure: 5 October–13 December 2026
- Reopening: 14 December 2026
- Opening arrangement: entire completed workshop in one opening

## Record attachments
- 03-building-records.md: coordinates, openings and retention register
- 04-operations-equipment.md: room relationships, equipment and operating hours

steps.userMessage:
COMMON REPAIR | An industrial hall for neighbourhood repair and making

We are converting our former assembly hall into a community workshop for household repairs, shared tools and small-scale making. The direction is fixed: exposed existing brickwork and steel roof trusses, repaired concrete flooring, and new freestanding rooms with birch plywood linings and glazed upper walls. The site measures 30000 × 24000 mm; the single-storey hall measures 24000 × 12000 mm and stands 3000 mm from the west, east and north boundaries. Its south yard is 9000 mm deep. Ground floor and yard share ±0.000; truss underside, eaves and ridge are +4.800, +5.400 and +6.900 respectively. Structural spacing is four bays of 5850 mm with an 11400 mm transverse span. The footprint, ten columns, five trusses, brick envelope, three door openings, two south windows and five rooflights stay in their recorded positions.

Organise Reception, Teaching, Making, Tool Store, Intake, Collection, Accessible Toilet and Staff Room around a public route at least 1500 mm clear. Visitors enter through D-01; repair items arrive through D-02 and move through Intake, Making and Collection. Tool lending remains visible from Reception. Course Day accommodates 12 learners, 8 makers and 2 operators; Open Workshop accommodates 6 learners, 8 makers and 2 operators. The building closes completely from 5 October to 13 December 2026 and reopens as one completed workshop on 14 December 2026. Print "COMMON REPAIR" and "Repair together" at the public entrance. Use "Course Day" and "Open Workshop" as the headings of their respective occupied views.

Audience: neighbourhood residents and workshop operators, for the layout decision and the refurbishment brief.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md records the fixed project direction and operating commitments. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists each deliverable's proportion, format and stage. 03-building-records.md contains survey coordinates, opening dimensions and the retention register. 04-operations-equipment.md contains room areas, adjacencies, equipment and operating states. existing-survey.png supplies the measured site, hall plan and transverse section. existing-exterior.png establishes the south brick facade and entrance character. existing-interior.png establishes the exposed trusses, floor and removable partition. courtyard-arrivals.png supplies the atmosphere of residents bringing repair items to the existing yard.

Deliverables:
1. One room specification document with the eight room IDs, names, net areas, clear heights, adjacencies and Ground Floor designation
2. One site plan showing the hall, south yard, public arrival and item delivery
3. One existing-and-proposed ground-floor comparison sheet with component IDs, the eight room names and areas, equipment footprints and floor level
4. One circulation plan tracing public arrival, tool borrowing and the D-02–Intake–Making–Collection item route
5. Two sections: a transverse cut through Teaching, a truss and a rooflight, and a longitudinal cut through the public route and new rooms
6. One south elevation with the three existing facade openings, entrance lettering and material labels
7. One dimensioned detail of the new plywood-lined wall meeting retained brickwork
8. Four eye-level views: south entrance; Course Day with 12 learners, 8 makers and 2 operators; Open Workshop with 6 learners, 8 makers and 2 operators; and item intake from D-02
9. One 10-second spatial walkthrough from D-01 through Reception to Teaching and Making
10. One presentation document of at least 8 pages reusing the room specification, plans, sections, elevation, junction detail and four views

Acceptance:
- Establish the room specification first. Repeat its eight room names and net areas on the proposed ground floor and in the presentation: Reception 18 m2, Teaching 54 m2, Making 60 m2, Tool Store 18 m2, Intake 12 m2, Collection 12 m2, Accessible Toilet 8 m2 and Staff Room 10 m2. Repeat its 4800 mm open-zone and 3000 mm enclosed-room clear heights in the sections and presentation.
- On the site plan and ground-floor comparison, dimension the 30000 × 24000 mm site, 24000 × 12000 mm hall and four 5850 mm structural bays; retain the register's component IDs at the same locations in the existing and proposed drawings, label P-01 Removed and new work New, and give north, metric scale bars and ±0.000.
- On the circulation plan and ground floor, dimension the public route at least 1500 mm clear, connect D-01 to Reception and Tool Store, and trace D-02–Intake–Making–Collection; place all equipment from 04-operations-equipment.md within the corresponding rooms.
- In the sections and south elevation, repeat levels ±0.000, +4.800, +5.400 and +6.900 and opening positions from 03-building-records.md. In the junction detail, dimension 18 mm birch plywood and the 20 mm recess; carry exposed brick, exposed steel and the new wall construction into the sections and views.
- Print COMMON REPAIR and Repair together on the south elevation, entrance view and presentation cover. Head the two activity views Course Day and Open Workshop and show 22 and 16 occupants respectively; match all four views and the 10-second walkthrough to the drawings' columns, openings, rooflights and material divisions.
- In the presentation, allocate at least one page each to the room specification, existing-to-proposed comparison, circulation, sections, elevation, junction, Course Day and Open Workshop; state the complete closure from 5 October to 13 December 2026 and reopening on 14 December 2026.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
